reviews.comment: She has very high expectations of her students but is very kind and fun!

Most accessible outside-class professor I've ever seen. Her feedback was constructive. Her grading was unique because we didn't get numerical/letter grades for individual assignments, which allowed us to learn and experiment with new writing genres without worrying about messing up our grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor! Writing has not been a strong suit of mine, but she gave enormous amounts of feedback that greatly improved my skills. Attendance and participation were very important, but she facilitated a very positive learning environment that made me want to come to class and not miss out. Took for Honors 210, Fall '23.

The best professor I have had at A&M by far. If you have a chance to take her I would 100% recommend. She really wants all her students to succeed and just wants to see you improve. Her class challenged me but she was always there to help. TAKE HER I PROMISE, so sweet!!!!

OMG BEST PROF! She is the most caring professor I had last semester and is very understanding and fair when grading papers. You have weekly discussions and four papers. All the papers are clear on what she wants and she really just wants to see you improve your writing skills! Would always recommend her to anyone!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I was very iffy when first registering for this prof but I had no other choice than to take the required course. Best thing thats ever happened to me. This is the most compassionate and understanding professor that Ive ever had in all my time in college. Very quick to respond to emails and WILL WORK WITH YOU! Loved her class. I highly recommend!!
